# issue: none
# notes: Four sequential branches deletion/recreation cycles; live population stays bounded; no cleanup or thousand-cycle evidence.

--- runner
timeout_ms: 60000
environments:
  - target: omnigraph-engine
    storage: local-filesystem

--- schema
node Item { key: String @key value: I64 }

--- seed
{"type":"Item","data":{"key":"baseline","value":0}}

--- loop $cycle 0 4
--- mutate
branch create "recycled" from main
--- expect ok

--- mutate branch: recycled
query add_temporary($v: I64) { insert Item { key: "temporary", value: $v } }
--- params
{"v": ${cycle}}
--- expect affected: nodes=1 edges=0

--- query branch: recycled
query cycle_rows() { match { $r: Item } return { $r.key as key, $r.value as value } }
--- expect unordered
{"key":"baseline","value":0}
{"key":"temporary","value":${cycle}}
--- expect shape
key: String
value: I64

--- mutate
branch delete "recycled"
--- expect ok

--- query branch: main
query current_rows() { match { $r: Item } return { $r.key as key, $r.value as value } }
--- expect unordered
{"key":"baseline","value":0}
--- expect shape
key: String
value: I64

--- endloop

--- query
branch list
--- expect unordered
{"name":"main"}
--- expect shape
name: String
